whyBuilt.title: Ihe Mere Anyị Ji Wuo Nke a Maka Naịjirịa
whyBuilt.description: Ndị Naịjirịa na-emepụta ihe wuru ya na Abuja, maka usoro iwu Naịjirịa. Anyị kwenyere na onye ọ bụla na-amalite azụmahịa na Naịjirịa kwesịrị ịmalite na ntụkwasị obi — n'ịmara na omume data ha na-echekwa ma ndị ọrụ ha ma azụmahịa ha. RegTrack dị n'ihi na nrubeisi ekwesịghị ịbụ ihe mgbochi nye ihe ọhụrụ na gburugburu teknụzụ kacha ukwuu n'Africa. Nke NDP Act 2023, Usoro Mmejuputa NDPR, na GAID 2025 kwadoro.
